$comment: Optimum RV CRM — action manifest. Generated from the data-action registry in crm.js. 'assistant' is the policy for an AI agent acting as the Assistant role: allow = may do unattended; propose = may draft/suggest, a person confirms; deny = people only.
confirm_means: The UI opens a sheet and a person presses Apply/Send. Actions marked confirm:true always pass through that sheet, whoever initiated them.

actions.description: Send a text or email to the lead, or add an internal note.
actions.effect: appends to lead.thread; first contact moves Assigned → Attempting

actions.description: Insert a saved reply into the composer.
Start a call to the lead (logs the call and outcome).
actions.effect: appends a call entry to lead.thread

actions.description: Book an appointment at a store's open slot.
actions.effect: creates a calendar event; appends 'Appointment set' to lead.thread

actions.description: Create an appointment or follow-up from the calendar.
Change one field of an event (type, customer, store, date, start, duration, notes).
Mark an appointment or follow-up done (or undo).
Push a follow-up to tomorrow.
Cancel an appointment with a reason.
Delete an event that was a mistake (use cancel for a customer backing out).
Add a follow-up for an event's lead.
Add a follow-up from the lead's quick-edit sheet.
actions.effect: creates a follow-up tomorrow 10 AM; appends to lead.thread

actions.description: Move the lead to Agreed (a person's decision).
actions.effect: lead.stage = agreed; appends 'Stage changed' with by:

actions.description: Move the lead to Lost with a reason.
actions.effect: lead.stage = lost; reason kept on the card and thread

actions.description: Bring a Lost lead back to Working.
Set any stage from the quick-edit sheet (manager override; backward moves need a reason).
Reassign the lead to another salesperson (management).
Create a lead by hand (walk-in, phone-up).
actions.effect: adds a lead in Assigned with a first thread entry

actions.description: Consignment: record that the consignor agreed the listing price.
Consignment: send the periodic report to the consignor.
actions.effect: appends an automated email to lead.thread

actions.description: Back office: book the unit's pickup.
Consignment: ask for a condition re-evaluation.
actions.effect: creates a follow-up for the lister

actions.description: Back office: set who a deal is waiting on.
Retry a message that failed to send.

reads.description: Every lead the actor can see, with stage, owner, tabs, card (timer, flag, activity), textOptIn and the full thread.
Typed log: message (dir in|out, text, meta, by), email, call (with recording/transcript), image, event (system/user actions), day markers.
Appointments, deliveries/drop-offs and follow-ups: date, start/end, lead, store, type, state, done.
Ordered stages per desk; 'terminal' marks Lost. Stages move from logged activity; Agreed/Lost are human decisions.
Stores with hours per weekday and reps — the source for open slots (crmSlotsFor).
How the phone's focus row ranks leads: timers, overdue, today's appointments, unread.

provenance: Every thread entry may carry by: 'system' | 'assistant' | a person's name. Messages drafted by the assistant and sent by a person carry by:'assistant' and sentBy:'<name>'. The UI labels these; never strip them.
not_yet: an events feed (the list above is computed in the UI today)
a schema for stages/timers/overdue rules (see HANDOFF → Status rules)
